offering_description.value: National Beverage sells flavored sparkling water, soft drinks, juice beverages and energy drinks to retailers, distributors and foodservice operators. It makes and packages the beverages at its plants and reaches consumers through retailer warehouses and direct store delivery.

primary_products.value: flavored sparkling water; carbonated soft drinks; juices and juice drinks; energy drinks

customer_segment.value: B2B: grocery and mass-market retailers, convenience chains, beverage wholesalers and foodservice operators; B2C: consumers buying packaged nonalcoholic beverages through retail outlets

end_markets.value: packaged nonalcoholic beverages for take-home, on-the-go and foodservice consumption

revenue_model.value: product sales: cases of packaged beverages sold to retailers, wholesalers and foodservice customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: turns beverage ingredients and packaging into finished drinks for retailers, wholesalers and foodservice operators; distributor: ships finished beverages to retailer warehouses and delivers directly to stores

geography_served.value: North America: United States nationwide and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: sparkling water, soft drinks, juice beverages and energy drinks share production and distribution channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: retail chain accounts served through warehouse shipments and direct store delivery; distributors / dealers: independent beverage wholesalers serving retail and foodservice accounts; third-party retail: supermarkets, mass merchandisers, club stores and convenience stores
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: beverage manufacturing and labeling subject to FDA food safety and labeling rules and state container deposit laws
